run_srt_api_request: run the SRT API request function to generate text with token-level logprobs for a Harry Potter character
run_openai_api_request: run the OpenAI-compatible API request function to generate text with logprobs for a character prompt
run_pretty_print: pretty print token logprobs and top-k candidates from a SGLang generate response
run_concurrent_requests: run concurrent SRT API requests across multiple character names using a thread pool executor
test_logprob_assertions: test that input and output token logprob arrays match expected lengths and completion token counts
